_comment: OpenRouter. Every chat Model speaks Chat Completions except the GPT-5.6 Models, which speak stateless Responses. Chat reasoning is OpenRouter's reasoning object ({effort}, or {enabled: true} for on/off Models) plus include_reasoning; OpenRouter maps an effort onto an upstream token budget itself, so no budget is sent. A Model without a catalog ladder snaps onto none..xhigh, an id the catalog does not know is treated as a reasoning Model, and a Model whose reasoning is mandatory gets its lowest active level instead of off. Claude Models cache only at explicit cache_control breakpoints; other families cache implicitly and do not get markers. Responses accepts max_output_tokens and top_p as its only optional parameters and omits reasoning for effort none.

rules.note: GPT-5.6 keeps its reasoning across turns only on stateless Responses, which replays the exact output items; the :batch variants and auto-router slugs stay on Chat Completions.
Anthropic cache_control breakpoints on the last system message and the most recent history messages.
